source.author: ov
source.text: Sed scilicet ultima semper exspectanda dies homini est, dicique beatus ante obitum nemo supremaque funera debet.
source.text_original: Sed scilicet ultima semper / exspectanda dies homini est, dicique beatus / ante obitum nemo supremaque funera debet.
source.text_english: But surely the last day must always be awaited by a human being, and no one should be called blessed before death and his final rites.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: nec tamen ille qui peccat sperare debet perpetuam inpunitatem, quia nulla est perpetua felicitas, sed scilicet ultima semper dies homini dicique beatus ante obitum nemo supremaque funera debet, ut ait poeta non insuauis.
reuse.text_original: nec tamen ille qui peccat sperare debet perpetuam inpunitatem, quia nulla est perpetua felicitas, sed scilicet ultima semper dies homini dicique beatus ante obitum nemo supremaque funera debet, ut ait poeta non insuauis.
reuse.text_english: Yet the sinner should not hope for perpetual impunity, because no happiness is everlasting; but, as the not unpleasing poet says, no man ought to be called blessed before his death and his final funeral rites, for the last day is always there for a man.
